thread:
maria (docs): Quick heads-up — I'm opening a small PR to: rename the 'Metering -> Usage tiers' panel, add a migration note about tier attribution, and surface the new SDK header example. Draft: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234

cynthia (analytics): Thanks! Please include the 'effective_tier' calc we added last quarter — dashboards depend on it. Also add the grafana panel id (panel-usage-tiered-v2) so we don't lose links during the rename. :+1:

joel (platform): FYI the platform changed the rate-limit header name from X-Rate-Limit to X-RW-Rate for Dedicated customers in 2025. Docs should show both headers and a migration note for clients parsing headers.

sam (eng): Can you drop a short SDK snippet showing how to read both headers and fall back? Prefer a tiny, copy-pasteable JS example. Also add a note about burst credits not showing in per-minute rate plots (that's on the analytics side).

maria (docs): Good call. Proposed snippet:

```js
// preferred header fallback
const limit = res.headers.get('X-RW-Rate') || res.headers.get('X-Rate-Limit');
const burst = res.headers.get('X-RW-Burst-Credits') || '0';
console.log(`limit=${limit}, burst=${burst}`);
```

cynthia (analytics): That looks fine. Add a short comment that the 'burst' value is cumulative and not instant QPS. We'll add a dashboard note explaining how to interpret it.

maria (docs): Also planning a tiny migration subsection: 'If your dashboards link broke after panel rename' with the panel id and a 1-liner on how to update links. Draft sentence: "Search for panel-usage-tiered-v2 in your Grafana dashboards and replace old panel ids; if you rely on saved alerts, rebind to the new panel." Thoughts?

joel (platform): Short + actionable — good. Add a compatibility table showing: old header -> new header, old panel id -> new panel id, and whether Dedicated/Hosted is affected. Keep it compact.

sam (eng): I'll run a quick smoke test on Dedicated tomorrow to confirm headers present on canary. If I find differences I will post results in this thread.

docs-bot: PR opened by maria (docs) — CI queued, lint OK. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234 :github: 

maria (docs): Thanks all — I'll update the PR with the snippet, panel id, and a short compatibility table. Tagging @joel and @cynthia for one-line approvals. Targeting merge after green build, ETA EOD PST. :clock3:
